premise: Contemporaneous sustained spot agreement may improve BTC futures-flow continuation. Does not establish spot leads futures or temporal causal ordering.
data: Official Binance spot and USD-M BTCUSDT monthly 1m klines; quote volume and taker-buy quote volume. Existing futures raw reused.
imbalance: 2*taker_buy_quote_volume/quote_volume-1 for each completed minute, each market separately
LONG: futures imbalance>=0.2 in all last3 completed minutes. CF1 additionally requires spot>=0.2 in all same3minutes
SHORT: futures imbalance<=-0.2 in all last3 completed minutes. CF1 additionally requires spot<=-0.2 in all same3minutes
trigger: false-to-true of futures3minute condition; prior and current3minute windows valid in both markets. Treatment is subset of identical baseline events, not a separately timed spot trigger.
execution: Signal close time t. Entry at futures minute open t+60seconds (one full minute processing buffer); fixed-time exit open entry+hold. No simultaneous positions per side/config. No stop, no stacking. Opposite directions evaluated separately, not portfolio combined.
exclusion_reason: Previously recorded spot daily/monthly discrepancy; exclude from signal eligibility before outcomes. Never repair with future data.
funding: Common entry eligibility excludes entries whose maximum30minute holding reaches next00/08/16UTC funding timestamp. Log unexpected delayed exits crossing funding; such settings cannot qualify without funding model.
missing: No imputation. Missing/zero-volume/badflow minutes invalidate signal windows. Missing entry open reject; missing exit open wait next valid futures open and record delay. Unresolved positions retained, stop config.
cost: Fee3bp each actual leg notional (provisional50%cashback); additional roundtrip0/2/4bp gives nominal6/8/10bp. No60%rebate. No measured spread/Bitget fills. 50USDT fixed initial notional, no compounding/leverage/account simulation.
support: Report all counts and calendar-day frequency including zeros. Primary gate N>=1000 total,>=100 each year; frequent goal mean>=3 trades/calendar day and>=1/day eachyear.
economic_gate: Primary treatment net8 mean>0 and eachyear>0, support/frequency, net8 better than FUTURES_ONLY at samehold; both adjacentholds net8>0; no unresolved/fundingcross. Necessary not sufficient. If preliminary gates fail archive without parameter rescue.
uncertainty_if_gate_passes: Year-stratified7day movingblock bootstrap5000, preserve arm/day alignment for lift; family correction over all12 settings. No statistical qualification until dependence/multiple search considered.
attribution: Also report unblocked outcomes of same futures events classified by confirmation; overlapping diagnostic, not independent trades or causal treatment effect.
isolation: No2023+data; no threshold/exit search beyond12fixedcells; no reversal or rescue. Related prior flow/basis/ETHcontext campaigns disclosed. Research already reused, not independent validation.
